item.text: {"search_note":"I found no credible 2024 evidence that Erdoğan restrained police, gendarmerie, or prison abuse, accepted responsibility for foreseeable abuses, released political prisoners as an accountability step, or credibly corrected earlier state violence. The available 2024 record points the other way: continued impunity, political imprisonment, abusive proxy conduct, and selective punishment.","evidence":[{"title":"World Report 2024: Türkiye","publisher":"Human Rights Watch","date":"2024","url":"https://www.hrw.org/world-report/2024/country-chapters/turkey","summary":"HRW reports that torture and ill-treatment in police, gendarmerie, and prison custody since 2016 were rarely investigated, including beatings after the February earthquakes and a death in gendarmerie custody.
